title: olearia rotundifolia
intro: Olearia rotundifolia, commonly known as round-leaved bush daisy, is a shrubby plant native to the eastern coast of Australia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe and calm the respiratory system, as well as its anti-bacterial properties, which can aid in wound healing. Olearia rotundifolia contains bioactive constituents including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
